messages:
michelle-csm: Heads-up — SunVault renewal landed. They want to split the annual invoice 60/40 between their US entity and EU entity and switch from net30 to quarterly billing. Procurement says they can cut PO for the US entity only.

dante-custops: Ack. Any risk to the renewal if we require a single billing entity?

michelle-csm: They said it's a hard constraint from their finance team — EU entity needs to be on a separate invoice for tax reasons. They still want the same term length and seat counts.

olivia-finance: We can do split invoicing but need vendor code for EU entity + separate billing contact. Also need to confirm tax/VAT handling. Can legal approve contract split? @omar-legal

omar-legal: We can support a split invoice but need a contract amendment that references both entities and clarifies payment obligations. Two options: (1) single SOW signed by one authorized signer with addendum naming EU billing entity, or (2) dual SOWs under same commercial terms. Option 2 is slightly slower — require two signatures. What's SunVault's timeline?

michelle-csm: They're pushing for a June 1 effective date. Prefer minimal signer friction. They asked if one signer can sign for both entities (they say they have delegated authority docs).

sean-se: From onboarding side — production usage is steady: ~3k tokens/day, embeddings up 15% MoM. No feature blockers. Keeping them on a single service tier is fine. If we split invoices we need to ensure Dedicated plan mapping stays consolidated in our billing configs.

olivia-finance: If we accept a single signer, we need evidence of delegated signing authority. Also procurement wants the PO number to match the invoice entity. Can SunVault provide two POs (one per entity) or a single PO that references both entity codes?

michelle-csm: I asked them. They can provide two POs but only one signer. They can upload delegated auth letter. I'll share when received.

omar-legal: OK. Drafting a short amendment for option (1) that allows split invoicing while maintaining a single SOW and single effective date. Will include clause: "Billing and tax obligations are as specified in Appendix A (entity split)" and signer confirmation block. ETA EOD tomorrow.

olivia-finance: Once amendment ready, Finance needs: vendor codes for both entities, PO numbers, billing contacts, and VAT ID for EU entity. Please confirm the invoice delivery method (email vs accounting portal).

michelle-csm: SunVault prefers emailed invoices to ap-eu@sunvault.co and ap-us@sunvault.com. They'll upload delegated auth to the Docusign envelope.

sean-se: Quick note — if they keep Dedicated capacity mapping to one account, we should flag internal ticket to ensure usage-based metrics still consolidate under the commercial account. I'll open an infra tag after legal confirms.

docu-sign-bot: New envelope created: https://docusign.com/sunvault/ENVELOPE-001 — includes amendment + delegated authority upload. Signer: "Jamie Park (SunVault CFO)".

michelle-csm: Perfect. After Jamie signs, Olivia — can you confirm Finance will accept two POs with one signer and process split invoicing?

olivia-finance: Yes — pending delegated auth doc. I'll queue this for expedited processing once signed.

omar-legal: Amendment ready and uploaded to the envelope. Minor ask: include explicit KMS key reference for customer-managed keys if SunVault wants that option.

michelle-csm: SunVault asked about KMS onboarding in the same convo earlier. They may request KMS in a month. For now they just want billing split.

dante-custops: From renewal risk POV — low as long as we accept the delegated signer + process two POs. If legal or finance push too many blockers, risk goes medium. I'll track.

michelle-csm: Thanks team. I'll monitor the DocuSign envelope and post updates here. If Jamie signs today, we can hit the June 1 effective date and finalize split invoicing workflow. :thumbsup:
